use_case: Generate a reviewable customer-history SDP pipeline from mock change events
assumptions: Bounded complete mock feed; all previous events remain available on every refresh.
UPSERT is a full image; sequence is a positive integer unique per customer.
Event IDs are global; conflicting identity/sequence or timestamp order fails preparation.
Late arrival is supported by sorting sequence; a retroactive event requires the complete feed.
DELETE of an absent customer is a no-op; reinsertion starts a new interval.
Email normalization is lowercase with a minimal format check, not full RFC validation.
Only development is deployed. No streaming CDC or autonomous repair in this MVP.
